auto-pull.description: Synchronize the configuration repository at session start.

auto-push.description: Synchronize local configuration changes when a session stops.

detect-leaked-toolcall.description: Detect leaked raw tool-call markup before a response completes.

guard-charsheet-missing.description: Block video generation when characters are present but character sheet reference is missing.

guard-destructive-and-resolution.description: Block destructive deletion and unapproved media-generation settings.

guard-file-revert.description: Detect edits based on stale file contents before a write.

hook-health-check.description: Report unresolved or inconsistent hook registrations at session start.

memory-inject.description: Inject the global memory context at session start.

memory-inject-project.description: Inject project-scoped memory at session start.

memory-sync-codex.description: Regenerate Codex cross-agent instructions from shared memory.

pixel-agents-shim.description: Forward hook events to the Windows-only Pixel Agents integration.

record-file-snapshot.description: Record the content last seen or written by the agent.

warn-bash-overwrite.description: Warn about shell redirection that may overwrite a file.

warn-tu-encoding.description: Warn about ToolUniverse encoding hazards on Windows.
